## Getting Frankenstein from Guttenberg

I asked Claude for help with code, but it gave me a mirror message. I found code on-line to fix here: <https://forum.posit.co/t/cant-download-books-from-gutenbergr/93961/2>

```{r}
# Install required packages if not already installed
if (!require(gutenbergr)) {
  install.packages("gutenbergr")
}
if (!require(dplyr)) {
  install.packages("dplyr")
}
if (!require(tidytext)) {
  install.packages("tidytext")
}

# Load libraries
library(gutenbergr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidytext)

# Mary Shelley's Frankenstein is book ID 84 in Project Gutenberg
frankenstein_id <- 84

# Download the full text of Frankenstein
frankenstein_text <- gutenberg_download(frankenstein_id, mirror = "http://mirror.csclub.uwaterloo.ca/gutenberg/")

# View the structure of the dataframe
str(frankenstein_text)

# Display the first few rows of the dataframe
head(frankenstein_text)

# Get basic information about the text
cat("Total lines in Frankenstein:", nrow(frankenstein_text), "\n")

# Optional: Convert to a tidier format with one word per row
frankenstein_words <- frankenstein_text %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, text)

# View the word structure
head(frankenstein_words)

# Count of unique words
unique_words <- length(unique(frankenstein_words$word))
cat("Number of unique words in Frankenstein:", unique_words, "\n")
```
